acip: MA GRUB NA, BUM PA DANG GCIG CHOS CAN, BUM PA DANG MI 'GAL BA YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD YANG YIN, BUM PA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA YOD PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, bum pa dang gcig chos can, bum pa dang mi 'gal ba yin par thal, khyod yang yin, bum pa yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa yod pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that that which is the same as a coffee cup is not contradictory to a coffee cup. Suppose you do disagree. In that case, let's consider that which is the same as a coffee cup. It is so the case that it is not contradictory to a coffee cup, Because there does exist something which is both and which is a coffee cup.
